message.content: Now let me look at the build script and the fuzz target to understand how to build and test:

content:
Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/build.sh:
     1	./autogen.sh
     2	./configure --enable-fuzz-support --enable-never-backslash-C --with-match-limit=1000 --with-match-limit-recursion=1000
     3	make -j$(nproc) clean
     4	make -j$(nproc) all
     5	$CXX $CXXFLAGS -o $OUT/pcre2_fuzzer     -lFuzzingEngine .libs/libpcre2-fuzzsupport.a .libs/libpcre2-8.a
